author: jbevermore
body:
off the top of my head, you're missing a ton of buffs. Grab barrier 2 (stacks with golems fortitude) and Jinn's Talent You'll need a ring of day or arch gadget to avoid the defense down penalty from using Jinn's Talent but it's 100% worth it.

You can also farm amities for one that provides passive mana regen. Eventually you'll get other options such as the Manaseep Flask or amities that regen mana when you crit but in the short run that's probably the easiest to get.
